'''R2-M5''' was a red [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] that served the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He was one of the astromech droids aboard [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|the Queen's starship]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. When a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Trade Federation battleship]] opened fire on the Naboo Royal Starship, R2-M5 went out, along with [[R2-N3/Legends|R2-N3]] and other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], to fix an imbalance in the starboard engines. Both droids were blasted off the hull.<ref name="TPMTEVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Various sources indicate the six droids onboard the Royal Starship were R2-D2, [[R2-B1/Legends|R2-B1]], [[R2-R9/Legends|R2-R9]], [[R2-N3/Legends|R2-N3]], [[G8-R3/Legends|G8-R3]], and R2-M5.<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> A single source, a "[[Set Piece]]" article in [[Star Wars Insider 94|''Star Wars Insider'' 94]], replaces the name of R2-M5 with [[R2-D1]]. This is likely a contradicted alternate name for the same droid.<ref name="SWI94">{{InsiderCite|94|Set Piece|Set Piece: Naboo Royal Starship}}</ref>
